item.title: Plane makes emergency landing at RDU after smell of smoke
item.description: According to American Airlines, American Eagle flight 5201 operated by PSA Airlines (a subsidiary of American Airlines based in Charlotte) made an emergency landing just after taking off due to a reported smell. RDU said the planed made a safe landing at 8:35 p.m.

item.title: Hand recount finds no change in Berger-Page NC Senate primary race
